verdict.rationale: Omnirush is a desktop app where an AI coding agent works directly on the user's own projects. It can review pull requests and offers selectable models and effort levels per chat, so it produces AI-generated suggestions from the user's code inside the product. However, nothing documents a dedicated insights or suggestions feature that analyzes the user's data more broadly; the support is implied through the chat-driven agent workflow. Missing for 10: an explicit data-insights or proactive-suggestions feature, docs describing what kinds of analysis it surfaces, independent or hands-on corroboration.
